title: 第一卷 第15章 护犊子第一卷 第16章 何为天才
slug: 失踪十年小师妹让全宗门跪下迎接
content_zh:
听见洛还真的话，学宫里的弟子忍不住笑出声来。
简直是大话连篇。
一万多种困魔阵法，就算是常年负责教宗门弟子阵法的覃长老也只会六七千种而已。
洛还真竟然说自己全都会。
苏明月忍不住道：“小师叔。你若不会便说不会，不能为了压我一头撒谎呀。”
洛还真不想搭理苏明月，两条小短腿往地上一坐，就开始画困魔阵。
在所有人震惊的视线注视下，洛还真又快又好地画完覃长老考核的十个困魔阵。
她起身，声音清脆响亮：“喏。本尊画好啦。”
覃长老错愕了一瞬，才走上前检查。
十个困魔阵，竟真的无一错误。
想要出风头打压洛还真，提升自己宗门存在感的苏明月一下子呆住了。
她一脸尴尬地替自己找补：“呵呵，小师叔真……真厉害啊。你刚看玉简的时候，一脸对书中内容无法理解的模样，明月还以为你不会呢。不过十个，十个也不能称之为全都会……以后小师叔还是不要夸大其词为好。”
洛还真闻言，一脸冷酷道：“本尊没有夸大其词。本尊就是全都会，本尊无法理解是因为里面有一些阵法画错了。”
覃长老一愣，继而板起脸来，“这《困魔通史》是沿用了五百多年的书简，不可能有错。”
“真的错辣！”洛还真干脆掰起手指开始报数，“第五百三十六章的锁云阵，第一千六百二十章的未央阵法还有第三千一百四十五章的清风阵……”
她在万魔窟遇见的魔魔们，起码有好几万种呢。
她每次画错阵法都要受很重的伤，所以阵法绝对绝对不能画错的！
这很重要，必须纠正。
覃长老则在听见她开始报阵法之后，用神识打开了玉简开始一个一个核对。
洛还真说得越多，她越是感觉心惊。

且不论阵法有没有错，光是这么短的时间里她能将每个阵法所在的章回记下来了就已经很让人不敢置信了。
嘶——这是何等妖孽的记忆力！
“阵法真假的事情，我会亲自去处理。”覃长老顿了顿，一脸慈祥地摸了摸面前小豆丁的头，“今日的课程还真合格了，下去吃饭吧，多吃点。”
语气满是心疼。
都六岁了，小身板看上去还跟三四岁小孩似的。
苏明月坐在自己的位置上，手指绞着衣袖，心情不是很好。
她是第一个完成课程目标的，但是没有一个人关注她，所有人的注意力全都聚焦在洛还真身上。
她本来是想踩着洛还真彰显自己，现在反而成了小丑。
苏明月望着覃长老和洛还真沉默了一会儿，突然开口道：“小师叔以前学过《困魔通史》？”
洛还真正准备溜去吃饭呢，冷不丁听见这酸溜溜的一句话。
本来都不想理她，但她非要来找不痛快。
洛还真看向苏明月，双手小老太似的拢在袖中，失望地摇头叹气。
“明月师侄啊。冒充十年天才，你还是对天才一无所知……菜，就多练。”
“你！”苏明月脸色瞬间煞白，一下子就红了眼眶，呼吸急促而微弱，像是下一刻就要碎掉，她扭头委屈地望着雷子越，豆大的眼泪便啪嗒啪嗒掉了下来。
“洛还真，你过分了！”雷子越一边哄着给苏明月擦眼泪，一边怒声呵责洛还真：“是！你是过目不忘，一目千行，四岁阵法相关你便能无师自通！但你也不能仗着天资卓绝欺负明月！”
苏明月掉眼泪的动作都不由得顿了一瞬，心里恨得牙痒痒。
二师兄到底怎么回事？
她是让他来救场的，不是让他佐证洛还真到底有多天才的。体修都是傻逼吧，肌肉全长脑子里去了？
就在这时，一道清翠的身影出现在学宫的门口。
“谁在说我家真真。”

洛还真眼睛一亮，像个小炮弹一样朝他飞奔过去，抱住了他的大腿。
“师尊！”
学宫中众弟子立刻起身，齐刷刷喊道：“见过太上长老！”
content_en:
Hearing Luo Huanzhen's words, the disciples in the academy couldn't help laughing.
It's just a lot of nonsense.
There are more than 10,000 magic trapping formations, and even Elder Tan, who is in charge of the formations for the disciples of the Holy Sect all year round, only has 6,000 or 7,000.
Luo Huanzhen actually said that he knew them all.
Su Mingyue couldn't help but said: "Little Master Uncle. If you can't do it, just say you can't. You can't lie just to suppress me."
Luo Huan really didn't want to talk to Su Mingyue, so he sat on the ground with his short legs and began to draw the magic trap.
Under everyone's shocked gaze, Luo Huan really quickly and well finished drawing the ten magic trap formations tested by Elder Qin.
She stood up and said in a clear and loud voice: "Here. I have finished painting."
Elder Qin was stunned for a moment before stepping forward to check.
There is really no mistake in the ten magic trap formations.
Su Mingyue, who wanted to be in the limelight to suppress Luo Huanzhen and enhance her sect's presence, was stunned for a moment.
She apologized for herself with an embarrassed look on her face: "Haha, my junior uncle is so... really amazing. When you first read the jade slips, you looked like you couldn't understand the content in the book. Mingyue thought you didn't know how to do it. But ten, ten can't be called the whole city... I'd better not exaggerate in the future, my junior uncle."
When Luo Huanzhen heard the words, he said with a cold face: "I am not exaggerating. I am the Quanzhou City. I cannot understand it because some formations are drawn wrongly."
Elder Qin was stunned for a moment, and then said with a straight face, "This "General History of Trapped Demons" is a tablet that has been in use for more than 500 years. There cannot be any mistakes."
"It's really wrong!" Luo Huanzhen simply picked up his fingers and started counting, "The Cloud Locking Formation in Chapter 536, the Weiyang Formation in Chapter 1620, and the Qingfeng Formation in Chapter 3145..."
There were at least tens of thousands of kinds of demons she met in the Ten Thousand Demons Cave.
She would be seriously injured every time she drew the wrong formation, so she could never draw the wrong formation!
This is important and must be corrected.
After Elder Tan heard her starting to report the formation, he opened the jade slips with his spiritual consciousness and started checking them one by one.
The more Luo Huanzhen said, the more frightened she felt.
Regardless of whether the formations were wrong or not, just the fact that she was able to write down the chapter where each formation was located in such a short period of time is incredible.
Hiss - what a monster's memory!
"I will personally deal with the matter of whether the formation is true or false." Elder Qin paused and touched the head of Little Doudin in front of him with a kind face. "Today's course is really passed. Go down and eat. Eat more."
The tone was full of distress.
He is six years old, but his small body still looks like that of a three or four-year-old child.
Su Mingyue sat in her seat, twisting her sleeves with her fingers, not in a good mood.
She was the first to complete the course goal, but no one paid attention to her. Everyone's attention was focused on Luo Huanzhen.
She originally wanted to step on Luo and really show off herself, but now she has become a clown.
Su Mingyue looked at Elder Qin and Luo Huazhen and was silent for a while, then suddenly said: "Young Master Uncle, have you ever studied "The General History of Trapped Demons" before?"
Luo was really about to sneak away for dinner when he suddenly heard this sour sentence.
I didn't want to pay attention to her at first, but I was unhappy when she insisted on coming.
Luo Huazhen looked at Su Mingyue, folding his hands in his sleeves like a little old lady, shaking his head and sighing in disappointment.
"Senior nephew Mingyue. You've been pretending to be a genius for ten years, but you still know nothing about genius... just practice more."
"You!" Su Mingyue's face turned pale instantly, her eyes were red all of a sudden, her breathing was rapid and weak, as if she was going to break in the next moment. She turned her head and looked at Lei Ziyue with aggrieved eyes, and big tears fell down.
"Luo Huanzhen, you've gone too far!" Lei Ziyue coaxed and wiped Su Mingyue's tears while angrily scolding Luo Huanzhen: "Yes! You have a photographic memory, a thousand lines of sight, and you can learn all about formations at the age of four! But you can't bully Mingyue with your talent!"
SuMingyue couldn't help but pause for a moment while shedding tears, her teeth itching with hatred.
What happened to the second senior brother?
She asked him to come to the rescue, not to prove how talented Luo Huanzhen really was. Are you all stupid about physical training? Do you think the full length of your muscles is in your head?
At this moment, a green figure appeared at the door of the academy.
"Who is saying that my family is real?"
Luo's eyes really lit up, and he ran towards him like a cannonball and hugged his thigh.
"Master!"
All the disciples in the academy immediately stood up and shouted in unison: "I've seen the Supreme Elder!"
